notes.title: Increase in Tire Life and Bug Fixes for the Manager Mode
notes.notes:
Changes:
- The Tire Life for the default Soft Tires has been increased from 1.5 Laps to 2 Laps
- The Tire Life for the default Medium Tires has been increased from 2 Laps to 3 Laps
- The Tire Life for the default Hard Tires has been increased from 3 Laps to 4 Laps

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed bug where the player got stuck when pitting for new tires
- Fixed issue where the AI difficulty was set to 100% even when the parameters were set to 150%

Improvements:
- Improved the dynamic AI in duel mode
- The AI player that the user is battling against now has a golden color name

notes.title: Improved visuals along with tutorial bug fixes
notes.notes:
Improvements :
- Added option to enable real-time shadows in the settings menu
- Improved the flow of the tutorial

Changes:
- Added rewards button on the Main menu screen
- Increased the size of the confetti and humans in the crowd
- Tweaked camera angles for all 3 camera types

Bug Fixes:
- Fixed issue where the tutorial was completely broken after the previous update

notes.title: Update 0.2.1: Improved Matchmaking System and more AI Vehicles
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Matchmaking system now displays the race track that you'll be racing on, along with competition type, total laps and other game data 
- Added Matchmaking lobby so that you can practice while waiting before the race starts
- All 9 AI drivers now have their own unique set of dialogues

Changes:
- Reverted back to having a max of 9 AI vehicles
- Made some tweaks to the Camera FOV
- Reverted back to the previous car dimensions

notes.title: Update 0.2.1: Better sense of Speed
notes.notes:
A new update is out with the following changes:

Bug Fixes:
- The track was not getting rendered in Italy and Italy Reverse
- Sound gets muted every time a race is completed
- Race End screen does not reset and shows lap times for the previous race
- New Camera angle not working on several tracks
- Camera facing the wrong direction on race start should happen less frequently (Hopefully)

Improvements:
- Vehicle now gets Transparent when collision is disabled
- Sense of speed has been improved when racing
- Increased the delay in calling "Tire Dead" dialogue from 10 secs to 15-20 secs
- Vehicle Tilt has been readded

notes.title: Update 0.2.0: Dynamic AI, Improved graphics and a new camera angle
notes.notes:
New Features:
- Added Dynamic AI that changes its difficulty based on the race situation
- AI vehicles now have their own unique set of dialogues. And they say things based on how they are performing.
- Added a new camera angle (Third Person Far)
- Better graphics and lighting

Changes:
- AI vehicles are now limited to a max of 2
- Settings menu has been added on the tutorial
- Vehicles now say "Tire is gone" dialogue when their tires are less than 33 percent to remind the user to change their tires
- Info about Qualifying session has been added on the Quali intro screen to help new users understand the session structure.
- Game sound has been reduced
- Race Finish countdown timer gets displayed when 5 seconds are left for the race to get over instead of 20
- Reduced the size of the vehicles
- High resolution vehicle is rendered for the primary user
- Vehicle tilt effect has been removed 

Bug Fixes:
- Static sound when going through curbs has been disabled
- Issue where camera was facing the wrong direction on Race/Quali start has been fixed
- Issue where the collision got disabled when vehicles were racing wheel to wheel near the finish line.

notes.title: Update 0.1.9: Engine mode now affects Tire Degradation
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to v0.1.9

Changes:
- Setting the Engine mode on "High" degrades your tires faster when compared to "Normal" Engine mode. This adds another layer of strategy in deciding when to push or to conserve.
- Rain has been disabled in Series 1 to make it easier for new users to adapt into the game
- Assist mode is a bit stronger now
- ERS Engineer has been renamed to Power Unit Battery Engineer.
- The Default Wet tires now last for 3 laps instead of 4 laps
- Tire Engineers have been nerfed to allow room for more strategies in the later series.

Improvements:
- The tutorial has been remade with the intention of making the user feel less overwhelmed with new concepts

Bug Fixes:
- Lag spike when vehicles collided with each other
- Host was unable to join the game in party mode when the number of users that joined the party was 10

notes.title: Update 0.1.8: PARTY MODE TO PLAY WITH UPTO 10 FRIENDS HAS BEEN ADDED
notes.notes:
The game has been updated to v0.1.8

- Added Party mode, you can now create/join a room code to play with upto 10 friends
- Vehicle now gets less transparent when collision is disabled
- Made the road materials a little less reflective
- Bug where the player name does not show up on the Match introduction screen should happen less frequently

notes.title: Update v0.1.7
notes.notes:
Improvements:
- Added Weekly Online Fastest Lap Times on the Race Finish screen
- Ferris Wheel in Track Belgium has been removed as it blocked the view from the top-down camera

Changes:
- Tire Degradation now affects the speed of the vehicle more prominently throughout rather than just making the car slower on 0% tire life. 
- Removed Camera Vibration

Bug Fix:
- Incorrect Track image is displayed on the Match Found screen

notes.title: Update v0.1.6
notes.notes:
Changes
- Tire grip: The way the tires interact with the track now changes depending on the tire life and weather conditions.
- Reduced Tire punishment - The speed punishment for being on the wrong tires has been reduced. Also, the speed punishment for being on 0% tire life has been reduced.
- AI Speed: Has been reduced for Series 1

Improvements
- Collision System: Detecting when to enable/disable collision has been improved
- Visuals: Lighting has been improved

Bug Fixes
- Several Vehicles getting spawned for the same user
- AI vehicles appearing pink
- Camera shake when overlapping a player with collision disabled
- Other minor fixes

notes.title: Update v0.1.5
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Collision is disabled in Qualifying
- Collision is disabled when being overlapped
- Reduced the size of the HUD in the third person cam
Bug Fix:
- Player sometimes goes through the pitlane and does not pit
- Lap count does not increment sometimes
- Sometimes, the player's position on the lap statistics appears to drop to last place, even though they are not actually in last place.
- AI Pitstop improvements

notes.title: Update v0.1.4
notes.notes:
Changes:
- The speed punishment is a lot higher when using dry tires on wet weather and wet tires on a dry surface.
Bug Fixes:
- The tire changes its color to the chosen tire compound instead of being red all the time
- Minor bug fixes

notes.title: Update v0.1.3
notes.notes:
Changes:
- Tire Degradation has been disabled in the pitlane to prevent unfair advantage to those who have a pitbox in the front.
- Series 2 now includes the maps from Series 1 as well
- Soft Tires have been nerfed by 5%

Bug Fixes:
- Game crashes during matchmaking/match found should be less frequent now
- Issue where choosing wet tires twice results in getting a soft tire has been fixed

notes.title: MAJOR UPDATE V0.1.2
notes.notes:
New Features:
- New Third Person Chase Camera
- Minimap and Racing Line
Changes:
- Reduced turn sensitivity now makes following the racing line more important
- Assist more is now much less prominent
- Tire compounds now last for the same amount of laps across all tracks. (Soft 2Laps, Medium 3Laps, Hard 4Laps, Wets 4Laps)
- Tire Degradation has been turned off in Qualifying to allow the users to set more laps
- The speed of the Hard tires has been reduced
- Pit Limiter speed has been increased
- Weather change duration has been increased
- AI is weaker initially and gets more powerful depending on the series that the user is in.
Improvements:
- AI pitstop logic has been improved
- User cannot do a pitstop when entering the pitlane from the opposite direction
- Ghost mode gets enabled when the vehicle wants to pit and is near the pitlane
- For complete list check (https://trello.com/b/GqfMzeOw/formula-bwoah)
Bug Fixes:
- Several bug fixes related to Matchmaking and game stability
- And more!

notes.title: More bug Fixes
notes.notes:
- Added missing colliders in the tutorial screen
- More minor bug fixes

notes.title: Several Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
The following bugs are fixed:
- The tire select UI does not reset on the next game which causes issues with the tire selection
- Rewards cannot be claimed with the controller
- The PS4 button icons are not correct
- The pitstop button and the respawn button are the same when using the joystick
- Reduced the speed of the Hard tires to 0.8 (From 0.9) and reduced the speed of medium tires to 0.9 (From 0.95). Soft tires still are 1.0
- Series reward gets stuck on loading when the trophy count is the exact same as the required trophy
- Connection error everytime a new game starts
- The billing system is not working
- Music is too loud
- Temporarily removed the quit button until the crash bug issue is fixed

notes.title: Connection Error Popup Hotfix
notes.notes: Hot fix: Issue where the connection Error popup showed up after every game has been fixed.
